name: James Tomitake
source:
The owner of a famous gambling club in City 23, the "Rich Bamboo", which rivals Club Primavera in popularity — but similarly loses most of its customers after Caleb's take of power. He was said to be the most powerful boss after Caleb when the man was rising, but had pragmatically surrendered to him.

[source: TV Tropes]
